description: This script generates splash screens for iOS/iPadOS devices from an HTML template, manages splash screen files, and updates the index.html with appropriate link tags.

methods.name: getSplashFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for splash screens based on device, mode, and orientation.

methods.name: generateLinkTags
methods.description: Creates HTML link tags for all device configurations with media queries.

methods.name: updateIndexHtml
methods.description: Updates index.html with new splash screen link tags.

methods.name: generateSplashScreens
methods.description: Asynchronously generates splash screen images for all device, mode, and orientation combinations.
